title: Chapter 42 The Law Of Casting The Holy Court
content:
Chapter 42 The Law Of Casting The Holy Court

As for himself, the purpose of that exercise is to plunder those lucks in place of heaven and earth, or to put it another way, to secretly get a share of the pie and steal the fruits that originally belonged to him without heaven and earth noticing.

This is naturally very taboo, so the emperor is so hateful. A stable society is in line with the meaning of humanity, and it can allow the rapid development of humanity. A stable dynasty is not in his interests.

Long-term stability means that there will be no turmoil, the foundation of humanity will become more stable, and the heaven and earth will not get any luck.

If the lifespan of those emperors is short, that's all, just a few decades is not worth mentioning in the world with an ancient lifespan.

But if there is an emperor who wants to live forever, it is to tell God to let him starve, so as to fulfill his power and wealth, and no one will agree to it, right?

What's more, how could a heaven and earth with an extremely noble identity give in to an ant who was so contemptuous in his eyes!

The contradiction between the two is in sharp conflict here, and there is no reconciliation.

And those with extraordinary power are the chess pieces created by heaven and earth in order to stir the general trend of humanity.

whatever their original intentions? But they are all spies of their race, big spies, even more hateful than the traitors during the Anti-Japanese War in China.

What those traitors sell is just a country, and the people who rule this country are still human beings, even human beings of the same skin color. But what these traitors are selling is their entire race, making their race forever, forever and ever, becoming a hog in the world, cut by it over and over again, fattened over and over, and then cut again.

And the extraordinary power is the sharpest knife of the will of heaven and earth.

All groups with wisdom, or groups without wisdom, are born with a hierarchy of divisions.

All the people at the bottom, if they have power again, but do not have the status to match it, then what will happen?

From ancient times to the present, this problem has been clearly explained, the chivalrous use of martial arts to violate the prohibition, such as the use of text to violate the law. Mortals without extraordinary power will spontaneously fight for their own rights.

What's more, what about those who have mastered the unmatched power of ordinary people? It will definitely rebel by oneself, lay down a world, and be the boss. How could it still stay in the original place and let others squeeze it at will? This is counterintuitive.

This represents turmoil, and turmoil represents the stirring of humanity, then the luck will flow out, and heaven and earth have long opened its bloody mouth, waiting to suck the essence of humanity, so as to achieve his sublimation. The path of evolution.

Tiandao, through the chess pieces under his hands, constantly arranges, so that those who are favored by humanistic luck, or those key nodes, continue to destroy, that is, constantly generate plots, so as to disturb the humanitarian order.

Those who are destined to be born are born with countless luck, and Tiandao sends his cultivators to create all kinds of calamities and temper the protagonist.

The protagonist will lose a part of his luck with every disaster and hardship, and those cultivators will brazenly come to help the protagonist. will be plundered.

But the fate of the protagonist is often not very good. He who betrayed humanity, and lost the attention and favor of heaven, and it was a dream to want to be the same as before, to win over between heaven and humanity.

The way of heaven is public and private, and treats all things in the world equally. The reason why the protagonist was treated specially before was just because the protagonist could bring benefits to the way of heaven. Now that it has lost its effect, the protagonist will hear again and become an ant in his eyes. .

As for humanity, let alone. No matter who it is, they all hate traitors, and this hatred even surpasses the enemy.

From ancient times to the present, throughout history, you can find that if the enemy falls into your own hands, many people can survive, but if it is a traitor, you have seen a few who can survive in the end.

Name a few of the more famous traitors. During the Three Kingdoms period, Lu Bu first betrayed Ding Yuan, then Dong Zhuo, and then Liu Bei, and he ended up with a white gate. When Wu Sangui entered the border with the Qing army, the Qing army flattered him in every possible way, and the king split the earth, but once he stabilized, he would immediately cut down the clan, and he himself was one of them, and he could not die.

These two people didn't fall into the hands of their own people, but into the hands of the people they wanted to rely on. Even so, how would they treat those who were betrayed? it goes without saying.

For those cultivators, it is no longer possible for them to obtain the protagonist of the atmosphere. There is no longer any use value, and there is no longer so much care and attention before.

This is also why when the protagonists started, the people of the world, Yun Congjingji, could not wait to turn around him one by one, and they were the center wherever they went, and they were able to provoke major events. But after a while, it wasn't like that.

This is like Guo Jing is to Yang Guo, and Zhang Sanfeng is to Zhang Wuji. Aren't they the protagonists for a while? But after a period of time, does it really have the scenery and spirituality of the protagonist?

Therefore, the core content of this exercise is to replace the original spiritual creatures of that world with the people belonging to one's own empire.

Or let the spiritual creatures of that world be branded as belonging to their own empire.

In this way, the humanity produced by that creature and the Qi Luck he extracted are also branded with his own brand, so that he can continuously provide the Human Dao Qi Luck that he can use at will.

In the process, I can destroy the so-called established plot as much as I like. Destroying the plan of Heaven again and again, so as to gain the support and trust of humanity, and moisten things in silence.

When the power of Heavenly Dao was disturbed by his constant fluctuations, and Human Dao's vigilance towards himself was greatly reduced because of his previous actions.

At that time, it will be time to throw out his fangs.

The way of heaven, which originally tended to be orderly, has become extremely chaotic because of his constant provocation, and has lost its original impeccable state.

It is also mutually intriguing with the human beings who are motivated by oneself, but there is not much difference between the two existences in terms of the existence of life. It is only that one is influenced by life and the other is influenced by the world.

The strength of the two people is constantly passing and depleting, and he can steal the exposed air luck value from the two.

As the luck value increases, the influence of oneself in this world becomes more and more great, and slowly, oneself can also master the authority of this world and all beings.

When he has more and more authority in this world and all beings in the world, he can completely kick out the Dao of Heaven and Dao of humanity, turning them into slaves and working for himself.

Therefore, this practice can be said to be envied by heaven, envied by others, and enemies of the whole world.

People who practice this practice will naturally inherit all the hatred of this practice, even more serious.

Because a practice method is always a practice method, and no one is cultivating it, then it is of no use whatsoever. Once it can be used, its threat will appear completely.
